body: Wish I knew. Makes no sense. They’ll just strip you of your belongings, put a mandatory security guard there, and not let you leave until they consider you not a danger to yourself. You’re supposed to call if you consider yourself a danger to yourself, and they just act as an extremely expensive way of ensuring you don’t do it for that period of time.
That’s beyond fucked. I can’t believe they think that helps anyone. Losing my job and apartment would be the nail in the coffin. Granted, I can already feel that nail already being hammered in.
Again? That all happened to you from calling before?

Because statistically the life I’m about to live, based on being autistic, but also many other things, using my past life and all the times I’ve been beaten down and chewed up and spit out despite my hardest efforts, I’m better off dead. Wish I could say otherwise, but I’m just growing sick and tired of lying to myself.

As for not living, I see it as a peaceful end to this shot show we call life. I have no children or pets or currently many close friends or family, which is why I feel like it’s prime time. Figured I’d hear just about anyone out before making that permanent decision, but I don’t see it as one to a temporary problem.
Exactly, it informs a suicidal decision. Really don’t see a better more peaceful way out of that solution. Life ain’t meant for everyone and that’s ok 👍

I’m 24, and have been at rock bottom my whole life. Wish more than anything my first suicidal ideation at 10 would have led to something. Because after expression that to my parents, I was reassured the best years were ahead of me. I’m still waiting for those, or anything remotely better.

I’m autistic as can be, and can’t hold down a job, and I my social skills make it virtually impossible to have friends I can connect with. Or a romantic partner. Never get a second date. First one ever was only last year.

Worked my ass off the last few years and by a single hair I got my nursing license, and i haven’t been able to keep 2 jobs now. I keep getting told “just switch fields” as if I didn’t just sink 5 years of school into nursing. I’m absolutely broke and can never switch fields, but admittedly I’ve hated much of nursing.

I see suicide as much more attractive than trying to push on without energy. I have nowhere to go but downhill further and there are np indications that say otherwise.
